negative_findings: The local 79-row MLB bridge and 47-row The Show bridge are lower-bound historical snapshots, not complete NPB↔MLB universes.
Nonempty local bridge IDs are not compatible with the current100 production ID namespace as currently stored; exact current overlap is zero.
The Show special and non-Live cards cannot be mixed with the primary Live roster panel.
Multiple transition segments or editions for one player cannot be averaged into one lifetime value.
The prior 6-player/7-pair result remains a valid negative finding for an unrestricted direct numeric bridge but cannot justify excluding all other player-year evidence.
